info.name: Matrice del Destino Public Tools
info.description:
Numerical personal and couple matrices. Premium readings and PDFs are separate products.

Official website: [Matrice del Destino](https://matricedeldestino.it).

No API key. Per client: burst 10, refill 30/minute. Shared service capacity: burst 20, refill 10/second; at most 8 in flight. Honor Retry-After on HTTP 429/503. POST JSON: maximum 2048 bytes. No automatic retries. Dates are sent in POST bodies, never URL parameters.

request.description:
Calculate the numerical personal matrix using the site’s 22-number method.

No API key. Per client: burst 10, refill 30/minute. Shared service capacity: burst 20, refill 10/second; at most 8 in flight. Honor Retry-After on HTTP 429/503. POST JSON: maximum 2048 bytes. No automatic retries. Dates are sent in POST bodies, never URL parameters.

exec: pm.test("Version 1 or explicit refusal", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.expect(body.version).to.eql("1"); else pm.expect(body).to.have.property("error"); });
